name: In Good Taste
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Blech! This stuff tastes terrible! So much for that idea...

Wait, what's that? Oh, I know, I know, you think I shouldn't give up on this stuff. Well, okay then.

Uhhhh, I have an idea! Brilliant! Take this dew to my friend Sprinkle -- she's an excellent chef. Tell her what we're up to here and that we want to make it go down a little easier.

I mean, if it's going to taste that bad, it at least should have some kick to it... And I'm just not feeling it...
narrative.objectives: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak with Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Marin's a good guy, don't get me wrong -- just a little... eccentric, I'd say.

And of course he needs my help, yet again.
narrative.requestItemsText: So old Marin's up to it again, eh? What's this concoction made from?
